candidates.why_avoids_previous_counterexamples: Previous failures involved the converse direction (state2002=1 => state1536=0) or implications with different consequents (state1536=0 => state1558=0). None falsified this exact implication.
candidates.why_consistent_with_reachable_samples: The initial state has both 0. Other reachable samples either lack state1536=0 or, when state1536=0 appears, state2002 is not observed to be 1, so no counterexample is present.
candidates.why_nontrivial: The lemma restricts r_pipe_req only when mode is IDLE, allowing other modes to be 1, which is realistic.

candidates.why_avoids_previous_counterexamples: Previous falsified implication was (=> (= state1536 15) (= state79 1)), not involving state790. The falsified (=> (= state1536 10) (= state790 0)) does not conflict with mode 15.

candidates.why_nontrivial: Stall is not always 1 in other modes (e.g., state1536=10 can have stall 0), so the lemma identifies a specific mode-dependent invariant.

candidates.why_avoids_previous_counterexamples: No previous lemma tested this combination. The falsified (=> (= state1536 10) (= state790 0)) differs in consequent.
